notes: This sample preserves upstream identity for Epic 32 adaptation work.
The compose shape is derived from the official phpMyAdmin Docker image documentation; the Websoft9 docker-library entry is used as a secondary reference only.
phpMyAdmin is a stateless web client for external MySQL/MariaDB servers and has no built-in database.
PMA_ARBITRARY=1 lets the user connect to any server; login credentials are supplied at runtime, so no contract-level secret is modeled.
The Websoft9 reference includes a throwaway mariadb container for testing; it is intentionally omitted from the normalized template.
The first pass stores source metadata rather than a full upstream file mirror.
